rationale: Retain the canonical AES parent, retract the two erroneous pre-closing GIP and EQT rows that were stored as active ownership, and represent the consortium take-private only as a signed pending incoming transaction. AES remained publicly owned as of August 23, 2026; stockholder approval and HSR expiry did not constitute legal closing, and other regulatory reviews remained open.

beforeImage.name: The AES Corporation
beforeImage.subsector: Electric utilities and global power generation
beforeImage.description: The AES Corporation is a publicly traded power company with utility, generation, and renewable-energy businesses in the United States and international markets. Its customer base includes regulated utility customers, commercial and industrial buyers, and wholesale power-market counterparties. The company operates an asset-heavy model spanning utilities, thermal generation, renewable development, storage, and related energy infrastructure. Public disclosures reviewed here show that AES remained a public company at the time of the latest announced transaction and that its equity was broadly held rather than owned by a single infrastructure sponsor. In March 2026, a consortium led by Global Infrastructure Partners and EQT announced an agreement to acquire AES, with CalPERS and the Qatar Investment Authority also participating in the consortium. AES stated that the transaction is expected to close in late 2026 or early 2027, subject to shareholder approval and regulatory clearances.

afterImage.name: The AES Corporation
afterImage.subsector: Electric utilities and global power generation
afterImage.description: The AES Corporation is a publicly traded, U.S.-headquartered power and utilities company with regulated utilities, conventional generation, renewable energy, battery storage and related infrastructure across the United States and international markets. Its customers include regulated residential, commercial and industrial utility users, corporate and technology buyers, utilities and wholesale-market counterparties. AES remained publicly owned as of August 23, 2026. A consortium jointly controlled by GIP-managed vehicles and EQT Infrastructure VI signed an agreement on March 1, 2026 to acquire 100% of AES through Horizon Parent, L.P.; CalPERS and QIA are also participants. Stockholders approved the merger and the HSR waiting period expired in June 2026, but other regulatory reviews remained open and no legal closing was found. GIP, EQT, CalPERS and QIA are therefore pending buyers, not current owners.
